scope: Channel averaging, ordinary vector or scalar time averaging and combined time/channel averaging for MeasurementSet visibility ordinate lists across correlation, scan and field panels.
baseline_result: Main refuses iterated visibility ordinate lists with averaging. The first candidate accepts the requests but orders reversed physical IDs incorrectly and rejects five panels on a two-by-two grid.
evidence_reuse: The full iteration suite passed before review. The reviewed diff reran the virtual time and fully flagged panel cases that changed, and checked the eight saved time pairs at absolute MJD-seconds tolerance.
